prompt:
Use the reference image ONLY for the character design language: googly eyes (round white eyeballs with black pupils), simple small mouths with no teeth, tiny stubby limbs made of the ingredient's own material, photorealistic food textures. Photorealistic cinematic food-character shot, vertical 9:16, camera at about 35 degrees above, medium close-up. One large round dark iron Chongqing hotpot (a single big pot, NO dividers, no grid) on a wooden restaurant table, filled with a shallow pool of glossy red chili oil that is just starting to bubble. Sitting in the pot, leaning back against the pot's rim like an old man relaxing in a hot spring, is a large block of Chongqing beef-tallow hotpot base: an opaque deep brick-red waxy block packed with dried red chilies and Sichuan peppercorns set into it. It has googly eyes peacefully closed (curved happy closed eyelids), a small content smile, and two short chubby arms made of the same red tallow resting lazily on the pot rim on both sides. Its lower body is softening and melting, glossy red chili oil spreading outward from it in rings. Steam rises gently around it. On the pot rim nearby, three whole dried red chaotian chilies and a few Sichuan peppercorns are little characters too: each with tiny googly eyes, a tiny curious mouth and tiny arms, clinging to the rim and peeking over at the relaxing tallow block. Warm tungsten restaurant lighting, rich red and amber tones, oily glistening highlights, shallow depth of field, cute food-character animation in a photorealistic style, appetizing, film grain. No humans, no text, no logos.
画面要求：背景不透明，纸面或底色铺满整个画面，不要透明、镂空或黑色边角区域。
